description: This file defines the VoiceWakeCommandExtractor object, which provides a method to extract wake commands from input text based on trigger words. It includes logic for parsing and cleaning the extracted command string.

classes.name: VoiceWakeCommandExtractor
classes.description: An object providing functionality to extract commands triggered by specific wake words from a text input.

methods.name: extractCommand
methods.description: Extracts and returns the command following trigger words in a given text, or null if none found.
